topics.title: Confused Caller Questions Daughter’s Marriage
topics.summary: A phone conversation centers on confusion regarding a daughter's marriage to an Indian man. The caller repeatedly questions the husband’s ethnicity, referencing clan affiliations and making comparisons involving Jewish ancestry and turquoise souvenirs, while expressing concerns about her marrying someone outside of their perceived heritage.

topics.title: Caller Expresses Frustration with Institutions
topics.summary: A caller expresses frustration regarding perceived elitism at universities and broader societal issues, questioning leadership qualities. The conversation shifts to personal anecdotes about attending a Black History Month gala and experiences related to relationships and social interactions.

topics.title: Radio Broadcast Discusses Prostitution, Priest & Iraq
topics.summary: During the broadcast, the host discusses reports of underage prostitution in New York City involving girls as young as eleven, followed by a story about a priest smoking crack and an agreement between the UN Secretary-General and Saddam Hussein regarding weapons inspections. Public opinion remains divided on potential military action.

topics.title: Box Office Revenue and Broadway Anticipation
topics.summary: Movie ticket sales continued their strong performance with ‘Titanic’ maintaining its top position at $21 million, while Adam Sandler held steady in second place. Discussions centered on potential box office strategies including a hypothetical Meryl Streep casting for 'Titanic', alongside anticipation surrounding Jerry Seinfeld's Broadway debut and concerns about scalping prices; David Duchovny’s departure from ‘The X-Files’ was disputed, and plans were announced for Michael Jackson’s ‘Stupidland’ theme park in Poland.

topics.title: Lewinsky Investigation & Florida Storm
topics.summary: Monica Lewinsky seeks a million-dollar payment for her story rights while authorities investigate an anthrax suspect and debate executive privilege. Simultaneously, severe weather in central Florida causes thirteen deaths as storm damage is assessed.

topics.title: Celine Dion’s Grammy Night & Tom Selleck’s New Show
topics.summary: Pop singer Celine Dion missed her Grammy rehearsal due to illness, potentially impacting her performance. Actor Tom Selleck debuted his new TV show ‘The Closer,’ reflecting on past roles and expressing reservations about its success.
